description: Compact research-derived Ascend optimization patterns. They are hypotheses gated by target CANN/SOC evidence, correctness and same-case measurement.

cube.canonical_flow: GM -> L1 -> L0 -> Cube -> L0C/FIX -> GM

mixed_cv.canonical_flow: Cube and Vector exchange staged tiles while adjacent independent work overlaps

patterns.title: Balance useful work across physical cores
patterns.when: legal independent work exists but task count or partition leaves cores idle or badly imbalanced
patterns.try: change logical task granularity or split an additional independent axis; preserve contiguous ownership where possible
patterns.avoid: oversharding tiny work or splitting a true recurrence/dependency chain

patterns.title: Keep recurrence chains local; parallelize orthogonal axes
patterns.when: one axis has true cross-step state dependency while sequence/head/row/other axes remain independent
patterns.try: assign the full dependency chain to one task/core and parallelize independent axes or small independent windows
patterns.avoid: cross-core state handoff per recurrence step unless the dependency graph requires it

patterns.title: Size buffers/rings from live ranges and cache fit
patterns.when: multi-buffer/ring/workspace depth is fixed, on-chip/cache pressure is high, or extra buffering stops helping
patterns.try: derive stage/ring depth from simultaneous live values and dependency distance; alias dead temporaries and keep only asynchronously accessed buffers multi-buffered
patterns.avoid: assuming more stages/buffers are always faster; do not double-buffer V-only temporaries without an async hazard

patterns.title: Schedule for cache reuse and bandwidth deconfliction
patterns.when: neighbor tasks reuse common data or many cores hit the same GM region at the same phase
patterns.try: evaluate grouped/swizzled task order for L2/L1 reuse and phase-shift independent traversal to avoid synchronized read conflicts
patterns.avoid: reordering across semantic dependencies or hard-coding a swizzle without shape evidence

patterns.title: Assemble fragmented data directly in on-chip staging
patterns.when: paged/sparse/indexed input is gathered into a GM intermediate before compute
patterns.try: walk indices/pages and assemble the compute tile directly into UB/L1, then consume it without a GM materialization
patterns.avoid: random tiny transfers whose issue cost exceeds saved traffic; preserve legal alignment/tails

patterns.title: Remove scalar/control work from short hot kernels
patterns.when: generic schedulers, div/mod, address math, tiny loops or repeated sync issue dominate a short kernel
patterns.try: hoist invariants, use incremental indices, simplify one-task-per-core regimes, batch synchronization where dependencies allow
patterns.avoid: large code duplication for regimes that are not measurably scalar-bound

patterns.title: Use bounded shape-regime autotuning
patterns.when: different shape/dtype/layout regimes prefer different tile/stage/schedule parameters
patterns.try: define a small hardware-pruned candidate set keyed by performance-relevant runtime attributes and benchmark same-case candidates
patterns.avoid: blind combinatorial search, fixed public-shape hardcoding, or using A3 winners as authoritative 910B winners

patterns.title: Audit generated hardware paths by dtype/shape
patterns.when: a supported dtype/shape unexpectedly underperforms or generated code may fall back to scalar/slow conversion paths
patterns.try: inspect generated target code/API template branch, then select a semantically safe hardware-backed copy/cast/reinterpret/specialized path
patterns.avoid: assuming API names imply identical hardware paths across dtype, shape, CANN or SOC

patterns.title: Pipeline MTE2/V/MTE3 across adjacent tiles
patterns.when: CopyIn -> Vector -> CopyOut is effectively serial and multiple independent tiles exist
patterns.try: use producer/consumer queues or explicit ping-pong with prologue/main/epilogue so next input, current compute and previous output overlap
patterns.avoid: buffering tiny tiles, exceeding UB, or adding barriers that recreate serialization

patterns.title: Fuse repeated full scans of a reduction axis
patterns.when: a long reduction axis exceeds UB and the algorithm scans it multiple times for related statistics
patterns.try: derive an online/corrected formulation that maintains sufficient FP32 state and reduces GM passes
patterns.avoid: changing numerical semantics or applying when scans are mathematically independent

patterns.title: Batch serial scan steps in UB and vectorize the orthogonal axis
patterns.when: a true serial scan repeatedly round-trips each step through GM but independent rows/columns exist
patterns.try: load several scan steps into UB, carry state locally across the block, vectorize the orthogonal independent dimension, then write once
patterns.avoid: parallelizing the dependency axis or choosing a block that evicts required running state

patterns.title: Vectorize scalar loops and use compound vector operations
patterns.when: many scalar/slice operations implement an elementwise pattern expressible as a vector tile or compound instruction
patterns.try: broadcast once, operate on whole tiles, and use supported fused operations when they preserve exact required semantics
patterns.avoid: extra broadcast/temp traffic that outweighs dispatch savings or precision-changing algebra

patterns.title: Use MicroAPI register microkernels for proven vector hotspots
patterns.when: profile shows a stable tiny vector inner loop remains instruction/dispatch-bound after higher-level fixes and target API supports MicroAPI
patterns.try: use RegTensor/MaskReg-level SIMD helpers, explicit cast traits and register-resident intermediates for the inner microkernel
patterns.avoid: prematurely replacing maintainable AscendC APIs, unsupported CANN/SOC paths, or losing tail/precision coverage

patterns.title: Preload across output-block boundaries
patterns.when: ping-pong overlaps inner K tiles but MTE2 still has bubbles between consecutive output blocks
patterns.try: move next block GM->L1 work into the current block lifetime and explicitly model prologue/main/drain
patterns.avoid: preloading data that shortens useful residency or exceeds L1/event capacity

patterns.title: Keep the reusable operand resident; stream the other side
patterns.when: one operand tile is reused across multiple opposite-axis iterations and fits L1
patterns.try: load the reusable side once, keep it resident, pipeline the streaming side, and choose task order/swizzle to maximize reuse
patterns.avoid: multi-buffering the resident operand without need or sacrificing too much parallelism for residency

patterns.title: Split a reduction axis when output tiles underfill Cube cores
patterns.when: M/N output tiles are fewer than useful AIC cores while the reduction axis is large enough to split
patterns.try: evaluate split-K or equivalent extra parallelism, including reduce/atomic/writeback cost in the model
patterns.avoid: trading a small utilization gain for large extra writes/reduction overhead

patterns.title: Decouple Cube/Vector with a bounded credit window
patterns.when: per-task ready/wait or reverse-flag handshake forces near lockstep although producer may safely lead consumer
patterns.try: use a counting-credit protocol so producer may lead by N tasks; derive N from true dependency distance and workspace capacity
patterns.avoid: unbounded producer lead, stale-slot overwrite, or copying another kernel's fixed credit count

patterns.title: Batch cross-core synchronization at legal intervals
patterns.when: cross-core flag issue/wait occurs every tile and synchronization overhead or bubbles are visible
patterns.try: signal/consume groups of ready tiles with a tail flush, choosing interval from dependency and storage bounds
patterns.avoid: delaying a dependency past the consumer point or omitting final partial-group signaling

patterns.title: Derive C/V workspace rings from liveness and cache fit
patterns.when: workspace ring is fixed/maximal, producer-consumer stages have different live windows, or larger rings increase cache misses
patterns.try: separate long-lived and short-lived temporaries, size each ring from its live window, and keep the working set cache-friendly
patterns.avoid: one global ring depth for all temporaries or treating deeper rings as monotonic improvement

patterns.title: Avoid GM materialization between Cube and Vector stages
patterns.when: a tile-local Cube result is written to GM/workspace and immediately consumed by Vector, and target mechanisms allow closer handoff
patterns.try: evaluate on-chip/direct handoff or the nearest legal staged buffer and synchronize only true producer-consumer edges
patterns.avoid: unsupported target paths, excessive on-chip pressure, or coupling that narrows legal shapes
